note: 人工双语文本，待配音，不虚构音频时间；减少噪音不能以漏报真实事故为代价。

series.title: 告警调整：降噪但不漏事故
series.premise: 短暂低流量错误导致重复夜间呼叫。团队核查误报、设计持续时间与恢复参数，用历史事故回放和影子规则验证。
series.outcome: 历史回放否决过长等待参数；保留快速严重故障路径与数据缺失告警。经过影子规则、受控路由测试和评审后发布较短持续窗口与恢复滞回，继续追踪检测延迟及遗漏。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 不实际呼叫的影子规则

recycling.note: 未来候选不计实际复现；旧引用仅使用p001–p350及本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 夜间页数不是唯一指标
dialogues.premise: 开始评审checkout重复夜间呼叫，尚未批准改规则。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清降噪目标不能替代事故检测目标。

lines.en: Okay, the alert is too noisy overnight. Twelve incidents... no, twelve pages from one burst.
lines.zh: 好，这个告警夜间噪音太多。十二次事故……不，是一次突发发了十二次呼叫。

lines.en: Were they duplicates or separate failures? Fewer pages aren't automatically better detection.
lines.zh: 是重复呼叫还是不同故障？页数更少不自动意味着检测更好。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we'll audit each page, right? No blanket mute for checkout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，每次呼叫都审查，对吧？不把结账整体静音。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for the request review. Maybe some bursts affected real customers.
lines.zh: 我有精力核查请求，有些突发可能影响了真实客户。

lines.en: Keep an eye on detection timing too. We need known incidents as test cases.
lines.zh: 也留意检测时间，需要用已知事故作测试案例。

lines.en: I'll gather incident labels and page timestamps. One action item is duplicate grouping.
lines.zh: 我会收集事故标注和呼叫时间，一个行动项是重复分组。

lines.en: Separate grouping from trigger changes. Otherwise we can't explain which change helped.
lines.zh: 分组与触发变更分开，否则无法解释哪个变更起效。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for that evidence? We'll decide after reviewing impact.
lines.zh: 那么，证据预计多久？看完影响再决定。

lines.en: By lunch for the initial set. Include quiet periods and severe outages.
lines.zh: 初始集合午饭前完成，包含安静期和严重宕机。

lines.en: I'll add customer outcomes, not dashboard color. Then we can inspect the burst.
lines.zh: 我会补客户结果，不看仪表盘颜色，然后检查这次突发。

dialogues.title: 短突发为什么被反复呼叫
dialogues.premise: 已汇总呼叫记录，用一个低流量案例检查误报与重复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分无需人工介入和没有客户影响。

lines.en: This false positive came from three requests. One failed, then traffic went quiet.
lines.zh: 这次误报来自三次请求，一次失败，之后没有流量。

lines.en: A request really failed, though. Why call the page false rather than harmless?
lines.zh: 确实有请求失败，为什么说呼叫误报，而不是说没有危害？

lines.en: Okay, no operator action was needed here. The retry succeeded; that failure still counts.
lines.zh: 好，这里不需要人工处理。重试成功，但那次失败仍要计入。

lines.en: Just to confirm, it's flapping around the threshold, right? Not twelve separate incidents.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是在阈值附近反复切换，对吧？不是十二次不同事故。

lines.en: Yes, repeated firing and recovery messages. Grouping can reduce duplicates without changing sensitivity.
lines.zh: 是，反复触发和恢复。分组可减少重复而不改变敏感度。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is sparse traffic distortion. Maybe a longer window helps here.
lines.zh: 当前假设是稀疏流量造成比例失真，较长窗口可能有帮助。

lines.en: It could also delay a real outage. Test that trade-off before accepting it.
lines.zh: 也可能拖延真正宕机的检测，接受前要测试取舍。

lines.en: Let me tail the log for timings. I'll match retries without exposing customer details.
lines.zh: 我盯日志核对时间，匹配重试但不暴露客户细节。

lines.en: An unlimited minimum-volume gate is risky. Low traffic doesn't mean low importance.
lines.zh: 无限制的最小流量门槛有风险，低流量不代表不重要。

lines.en: So, let's park that volume gate. Review missed incidents before designing the threshold.
lines.zh: 那么，流量门槛先放一边，设计阈值前先看漏报事故。

dialogues.title: 低流量也可能是真事故
dialogues.premise: 重复与稀疏流量已识别，检查改动可能漏掉的真实故障。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别独立严重故障路径的作用。

lines.en: Missed detection is our main risk. Last month's outage began during low traffic.
lines.zh: 漏检是主要风险，上个月宕机是在低流量时开始的。

lines.en: Okay, all checkout attempts failed then. A minimum request gate could hide that.
lines.zh: 好，当时所有结账尝试都失败了，最小请求门槛可能藏住它。

lines.en: Just to confirm, severe failure stays fast, right? We aren't delaying every page.
lines.zh: 确认一下，严重故障仍快速响应，对吧？不是延迟所有呼叫。

lines.en: Keep the independent transaction failure rule. Missing telemetry must also remain alertable.
lines.zh: 保留独立交易失败规则，遥测缺失也必须仍能告警。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on failed completions. Maybe latency failures need separate replay cases.
lines.zh: 我留意完成失败，延迟故障可能也需要单独回放案例。

lines.en: Yes, include slow success and total failure. An error-only test misses latency incidents.
lines.zh: 是，包含缓慢成功和完全失败，只测错误会漏掉延迟事故。

lines.en: I'm on it for those labelled windows. The escalation path stays unchanged during tests.
lines.zh: 这些标注窗口我来整理，测试期间升级路径不变。

lines.en: So, any missed severe case is a rollback trigger. Review quieter incidents too.
lines.zh: 那么，漏掉任何严重案例都触发回退，也评审较轻事故。

lines.en: Compare the old rule's detection time. The new rule must meet agreed deadlines.
lines.zh: 比较旧规则检测时间，新规则必须满足约定时限。

lines.en: Let's propose separate paths, not one mute. That gives the replay a clear question.
lines.zh: 提出不同路径，不做整体静音，这样回放有明确验证问题。

dialogues.title: 先定义检测时限
dialogues.premise: 严重故障保留快速路径，噪音规则需要候选持续窗口。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清候选参数尚未获准上线。

lines.en: We can tune the threshold for sustained errors. Start with a three-minute pending period.
lines.zh: 可调整持续错误阈值，先试三分钟待触发期。

lines.en: Okay, that's a working hypothesis, not approval. The short severe-failure path stays separate.
lines.zh: 好，这是待验证假设，不是批准，严重故障短路径另保留。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we'll dry-run it first, right? Old paging remains active throughout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先试运行，对吧？旧呼叫全程保持有效。

lines.en: Require severe detection within two minutes. Other sustained incidents must meet five minutes.
lines.zh: 要求严重故障两分钟内检测，其他持续事故必须在五分钟内。

lines.en: Maybe three minutes misses short real failures. We need those labelled in replay.
lines.zh: 三分钟可能漏掉短暂真实故障，需要在回放里标注。

lines.en: Agreed. We won't delete those cases. Threshold selection needs impact, not page counts alone.
lines.zh: 同意，不删这些案例，选阈值要看影响，不只看页数。

lines.en: My action item is an explicit missing-data branch. Missing samples must never become zeros.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是明确缺数据分支，缺样本绝不能变成零。

lines.en: So, the rollback trigger includes routing failure. A correct rule without delivery still fails.
lines.zh: 那么，回退条件包含路由失败，规则正确却未投递仍算失败。

lines.en: Record these gates before testing. Otherwise we'd change the standards after seeing results.
lines.zh: 测试前记录关口，否则会在看到结果后改变标准。

lines.en: I'll approve the labelled impact windows today. Then replay can challenge this proposal.
lines.zh: 我今天审核影响窗口标注，随后回放可以挑战提案。

dialogues.title: 历史事故否决长等待
dialogues.premise: 三分钟持续窗口进入历史回放，旧规则不变。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清失败结果如何改变参数。

lines.en: Historical replay caught the severe outage quickly. But it missed a two-minute customer failure.
lines.zh: 历史回放快速检出严重宕机，但漏掉两分钟客户故障。

lines.en: Okay, the pending period was too long. We can't rule that out as harmless noise.
lines.zh: 好，待触发期太长，不能把那次当无害噪音排除。

lines.en: Just to confirm, this candidate fails acceptance, right? Lower page count doesn't rescue it.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这个候选未通过验收，对吧？页数更少不能挽救它。

lines.en: Correct. Try one minute for sustained errors. Keep duplicate grouping as a separate setting.
lines.zh: 对，持续错误改试一分钟，重复分组继续单独设置。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis needs revision, not relabelling. Maybe test borderline cases near one minute.
lines.zh: 要修假设，不能改案例标注，也许测试接近一分钟的边界案例。

lines.en: I'll replay the full set again. Include ingestion delays and missing samples this time.
lines.zh: 我重新回放整套数据，这次包含摄入延迟和缺失样本。

lines.en: I'm on it for input completeness. Unknown windows won't be marked successful detections.
lines.zh: 输入完整性我来查，未知窗口不标为检测成功。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for revised results? We need timing and impact together.
lines.zh: 那么，修订结果预计多久？时间与影响一起报告。

lines.en: This afternoon, if labels are complete. Replay covers known history, not every future failure.
lines.zh: 标注完整的话今天下午，回放覆盖已知历史，不是所有未来故障。

lines.en: Agreed. Passing replay only permits shadow testing. It doesn't authorize replacing live paging.
lines.zh: 同意，通过回放只允许影子测试，不授权替换线上呼叫。

dialogues.title: 影子规则不实际呼叫
dialogues.premise: 一分钟窗口通过已知案例回放，进入影子评估。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分逻辑评估、路由测试和接管。

lines.en: Okay, the shadow rule evaluates live samples. It records results without paging operators.
lines.zh: 好，影子规则评估实时样本，只记录，不呼叫值班。

lines.en: Old rules still page normally. Don't create duplicate production notifications during this comparison.
lines.zh: 旧规则正常呼叫，对比期间不要制造重复生产通知。

lines.en: Just to confirm, managed configuration records both versions, right? Rollback stays straightforward.
lines.zh: 确认一下，统一配置记录两版，对吧？回退保持直接。

lines.en: Yes, but shadow evaluation doesn't test delivery. Run a controlled routing smoke test separately.
lines.zh: 是，但影子评估不测投递，另做受控路由快速验证。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on customer failures. Maybe shadow outputs disagree with live pages.
lines.zh: 我会留意客户失败，影子结果可能与线上呼叫不同。

lines.en: Each disagreement gets a labelled review. Our staged rollout starts with one service only.
lines.zh: 每处分歧都标注评审，分阶段发布先只覆盖一个服务。

lines.en: Don't count an unreviewed disagreement as improvement. It could be a missed incident.
lines.zh: 未评审分歧不能算改善，可能是漏报事故。

lines.en: So, three nights of observation before review. Severe-path failures stop the trial immediately.
lines.zh: 那么，观察三晚再评审，严重路径失败立即停止试验。

lines.en: I'll test the backup notification route today. The primary route alone isn't enough.
lines.zh: 我今天测后备通知路径，只有主要路径不够。

lines.en: I'll bring morning feedback from the on-call. We need usefulness, not just less noise.
lines.zh: 我带来值班晨间反馈，需要有用，不只是安静。

dialogues.title: 恢复消息仍然重复
dialogues.premise: 影子试验完成三晚，逻辑通过但反复恢复仍造成重复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别呼叫是否有明确行动。

lines.en: An actionable page needs a clear response. This rule now links the right runbook.
lines.zh: 可行动呼叫要有明确响应，这条规则现在链接正确手册。

lines.en: Did the primary on-call follow it successfully? A link alone doesn't make it useful.
lines.zh: 第一响应值班人成功按手册处理了吗？有链接不等于有用。

lines.en: Okay, the drill worked, but recovery still repeats. It's flapping after the burst ends.
lines.zh: 好，演练成功，但恢复仍反复，突发后状态还在切换。

lines.en: Just to confirm, pages still reach backup, right? We shouldn't fix noise by dropping routes.
lines.zh: 确认一下，后备仍收到呼叫，对吧？不能删路由来降噪。

lines.en: Both routes passed controlled tests. Repeated recoveries need state handling, not higher error thresholds.
lines.zh: 两条路由通过受控测试，重复恢复要改状态处理，不是提高错误阈值。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth to review state transitions. Maybe require sustained health before clearing.
lines.zh: 我有精力检查状态切换，也许清除前要求持续健康。

lines.en: That can help, but don't hide renewed failures. A new severe event must still page.
lines.zh: 这可能有用，但不能掩盖再次失败，新严重事件仍要呼叫。

lines.en: So, let's park that global threshold increase. Focus on recovery behavior for this rule.
lines.zh: 那么，全局提高阈值先放下，专注本规则恢复行为。

lines.en: Record first detection and each recovery. We need evidence that grouping preserves incident boundaries.
lines.zh: 记录首次检测与每次恢复，要证明分组保留事故边界。

lines.en: I'll label renewed customer failures separately. We shouldn't merge unrelated incidents for nicer numbers.
lines.zh: 我单独标注再次客户失败，不能为数字好看合并无关事故。

dialogues.title: 稳定恢复而不掩盖复发
dialogues.premise: 触发参数保留，重复恢复需要持续健康判定。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清恢复滞回不延迟首次检测。

lines.en: Recovery hysteresis requires two healthy minutes. It doesn't change the initial firing threshold.
lines.zh: 恢复滞回要求健康两分钟，不改变首次触发阈值。

lines.en: Okay, that's our revised working hypothesis. Renewed severe failures still enter the fast path.
lines.zh: 好，这是修订假设，再次严重失败仍走快速路径。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we'll dry-run it first, right? Replay incident boundaries as well.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先试运行，对吧？事故边界也回放。

lines.en: Test recovery followed by another outage. Grouping must not suppress a genuinely new event.
lines.zh: 测试恢复后再次宕机，分组不能抑制真正新事件。

lines.en: Maybe a long grouping window hides that return. Keep the deduplication scope explicit.
lines.zh: 过长分组窗口可能藏住复发，要明确去重范围。

lines.en: Use incident state, service, and alert identity. Don't group every checkout problem together.
lines.zh: 使用事故状态、服务和告警身份，不把所有结账问题一锅合并。

lines.en: I'm on it for repeat-outage tests. Any suppressed severe page remains a rollback trigger.
lines.zh: 重复宕机测试我来做，严重呼叫被抑制仍触发回退。

lines.en: So, compare old and revised outputs again. Parameter changes invalidate the earlier acceptance result.
lines.zh: 那么，再比较旧版与修订版，参数变化使此前验收结果失效。

lines.en: The revised set passes labelled cases now. Controlled routing also preserves new incident pages.
lines.zh: 修订集合现通过标注案例，受控路由也保留新事故呼叫。

lines.en: I'll sign the customer-impact review after reading it. Then we can discuss production approval.
lines.zh: 我读完后签客户影响评审，随后才讨论生产批准。

dialogues.title: 带时限和回退的批准
dialogues.premise: 修订回放和路由测试通过，进入变更审批。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住批准范围及监护人。

lines.en: Detection latency meets our recorded gates. Known severe cases arrive within two minutes.
lines.zh: 检测延迟满足记录关口，已知严重案例两分钟内到达。

lines.en: Okay, go/no-go is ready for checkout only. Managed configuration stores the approved version.
lines.zh: 好，继续或停止决策仅针对结账，统一配置保存批准版本。

lines.en: Just to confirm, old settings remain recoverable, right? No unreviewed changes in this release.
lines.zh: 确认一下，旧设置仍可恢复，对吧？本次不含未评审改动。

lines.en: Correct. Switch one production rule after approval. Don't leave old and new paging together.
lines.zh: 对，批准后切一条生产规则，不让新旧同时呼叫。

lines.en: Maybe traffic changes after deployment. I'll monitor customer impact through the observation period.
lines.zh: 部署后流量可能变化，我会在观察期监测客户影响。

lines.en: A missed incident or late severe detection stops expansion. Routing failures count too.
lines.zh: 漏报或严重检测迟到就停止扩大，路由失败也算。

lines.en: That's our rollback trigger in the ticket. The staged rollout doesn't include other services.
lines.zh: 工单写了回退条件，分阶段发布不含其他服务。

lines.en: So, approved with Raj watching the first night. Report failures immediately, not tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 那么，批准，Raj守第一晚，失败立即报告，不等明早。

lines.en: I'll verify loaded rule hashes after deployment. A saved file isn't proof of activation.
lines.zh: 部署后我核对加载规则哈希，文件保存不证明激活。

lines.en: I'll join the morning review with request evidence. Quiet paging still needs an explanation.
lines.zh: 我带请求证据参加晨间评审，安静呼叫仍需要解释。

dialogues.title: 降噪还要查漏报
dialogues.premise: 新规则上线首晚正常，确定持续跟踪。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解降噪、遗漏和检测延迟联合验收。

lines.en: Noise reduction isn't success alone. Last night had fewer duplicates and no known missed incidents.
lines.zh: 仅降噪不算成功，昨晚重复更少，未发现已知漏报。

lines.en: One night is limited evidence. Compare incidents, timing, and routing over two weeks.
lines.zh: 一晚证据有限，两周内对比事故、时序与路由。

lines.en: Okay, action item: keep an eye on disagreements. Review customer failures without matching pages.
lines.zh: 好，行动项是关注分歧，评审没有对应呼叫的客户失败。

lines.en: Maybe support finds a missed short outage. I'll reconcile those reports each morning.
lines.zh: 支持可能发现漏掉的短宕机，我每天早上核对报告。

lines.en: Keep the missing-data branch tested too. Missing telemetry must never make performance look better.
lines.zh: 缺数据分支也保持测试，缺遥测不能让性能看起来更好。

lines.en: The severe path stays unchanged, right? I'll record any delay against our two-minute gate.
lines.zh: 严重路径保持不变，对吧？我按两分钟关口记录延迟。

lines.en: Yes. Repeat historical cases after future edits. This approval doesn't cover new parameter choices.
lines.zh: 是，未来修改后重跑历史案例，本次批准不覆盖新参数。

lines.en: So, just to recap, checkout only today. We'll circle back next Friday with evidence.
lines.zh: 那么，小结一下，今天仅结账，下周五带证据再讨论。

lines.en: I'll review the delivery audit then. Page counts and successful notifications are different measures.
lines.zh: 届时我评审投递审计，页数与成功通知是不同指标。

lines.en: We'll close the loop on customer impact. Fewer wake-ups matter only with reliable detection.
lines.zh: 我们对客户影响闭环反馈，少被叫醒必须建立在可靠检测上。
